observations: Photo 0: Large flat-panel TV mounted on a marble-look wall, showing LG webOS home screen with app icons (Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, DStv, Twitch, LG Sports Playbook, LG Gallery+).
Photo 0: A soundbar sits on a shelf below the TV, connected by a visible cable to a small black box.
Photo 1: Same TV showing a demo nature image (aerial island scene) instead of the home screen.
Both photos carry a visible watermark reading 'POSTED ON JIJI HARRY LAN', suggesting the images may be a repost from another listing rather than original seller photos.
No rating plate, serial number, or model sticker is visible in either photo.
No remote control, box, or stand is visible in either photo.
A wall clock beside the TV gives a rough sense of scale but does not confirm the stated 86-inch size.
No visible screen defects, but the demo content and store-mode-style UI make it hard to judge real picture quality.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows LG webOS interface branding
No model number, label, or rating plate visible in either photo
No scale reference or measurement visible; wall clock alone cannot confirm exact size
Demo images look sharp but photo compression and resale image reuse make resolution unconfirmable

claims.claim: AI Smart TV with advanced features
claims.evidence: webOS home screen shown, but no demonstration of actual smart features (voice control, AI upscaling, etc.) working on this specific unit

risks.risk: Photos may be stock/reused images (watermark says 'Posted on Jiji Harry Lan'), not the actual unit for sale
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the TV with a handwritten note/date and the seller's phone visible, or a video walk-around
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition/authenticity unverified, treated as higher-risk private sale

risks.risk: No visible model/serial plate to confirm exact model and size
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label usually on the back of the panel or lower bezel
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic large LG smart TV of unconfirmed size/model, not the specific 86UA85006LA

risks.risk: Screen could have dead pixels, uniformity issues, or panel damage not visible in bright demo content
risks.proof: Photo/video of a full-screen solid gray or black test pattern
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, worst case minor panel defects

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, stand/wall mount hardware, power cable, original box)
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Smart TV apps/account may be logged into previous owner's accounts or region-locked
risks.proof: Video showing a factory reset or sign-out from Netflix/DStv apps
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified, factory reset required by buyer

risks.risk: Soundbar included in listing may not be part of the sale (could be seller's own unrelated unit)
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing that the soundbar is included, plus a close-up of its model label
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV only, soundbar excluded

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating/serial plate on the back of the TV showing model number and size
A fresh, non-watermarked photo or short video of the actual TV in the seller's current location, with date/time visible
Photo of all accessories (remote, cables, stand/mount, box) laid out together
A full-screen solid color (gray/black) test image to check for panel defects
Confirmation in writing whether the soundbar is included in the sale
response.reason: The photos show a plausible LG webOS smart TV but carry a reused-image watermark, lack any visible model/serial plate, and give no scale reference to confirm the stated 86-inch size, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without a clearer, unwatermarked photo of the rating label and the actual unit.
